name: Plaid
description: Your Plaid dashboard: items, institutions, webhooks and API logs.
long_description:
Plaid's own hosted server, connected to your Plaid dashboard. It reads items and institutions, checks webhooks, and searches the API logs — which is what you actually want when a bank link stops working.

You sign in through Plaid in your browser.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Plaid in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reaches your Plaid dashboard. It is your integration's data — items, logs, webhooks — not your users' bank credentials.
